summary: Practise digital data collection, Excel checks and dashboards for social protection M&E. Explore the five-day course and its applied curriculum.
lede: Social protection monitoring and evaluation turns programme data into evidence about benefit delivery and outcomes. For M&E officers, programme managers and information-system staff, this intermediate course supports practical monitoring and reporting workflows. You will practise designing KoboToolbox forms, checking data quality in Excel, building indicator dashboards and using OECD DAC criteria to shape evaluation questions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who use social protection programme data to monitor delivery, assess results or prepare evidence for operational and funding decisions.
audience: Social Assistance Programme Managers using dashboard results
prerequisites: Prior experience with social protection programme operations, monitoring and evaluation, or routine programme reporting is recommended. Basic spreadsheet use is expected. Coding or programming is not required; advanced digital integration and evaluation design are introduced at operational application level rather than implementation-engineering depth.
